title: Riot reports record $647M revenue in 2025 as peers struggle
summary: Riot Platforms posted record 2025 revenue of $647 million, driven by $576 million in Bitcoin mining revenue, while holding 18,005 BTC worth $1.6 billion.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs see $458M in inflows as Mideast conflict widens
summary: US spot Bitcoin funds saw strong inflows and increasing volumes on Monday as institutional demand held up in spite of increasing Middle East tensions and broader market uncertainty.

title: Bank of Japan testing blockchain settlement for bank deposits in new sandbox
summary: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said the experiments will examine links between blockchain systems and Japan’s existing settlement infrastructure.

title: BitMEX co-founder pledges $27M to London maths institute after Trump pardon
summary: Ben Delo paid a $10 million fine after pleading guilty to US banking violations in 2022 and was granted a pardon by President Donald Trump in March 2025.

title: Bitcoin is forming a bottom as the 4-year cycle ends: VanEck CEO
summary: Jan van Eck suggested that analysts have been overcomplicating recent Bitcoin price action, arguing that the four-year cycle has been the main driver holding prices down.

title: Core Scientific shares move lower as Q4 earnings miss estimates
summary: Core Scientific missed revenue expectations in the fourth quarter as Bitcoin miners were squeezed by lower prices and higher costs.

title: Bitcoin slide slowing, but bear market still in play: Analysts
summary: Compressed volatility, strengthening ETF flows and a diminished Coinbase discount “are not characteristics of a market accelerating into a fresh leg lower,” said 10x Research.

title: ‘ClickFix’ hackers pose as VCs, hijack QuickLens in latest crypto attacks
summary: The ClickFix technique gained popularity among crypto hackers last year, but security researchers have been tracking it since 2024, with targets spanning several industries.

title: Nasdaq files for prediction market-style options on Nasdaq-100
summary: The offering could enable traders to bet on the stock performance of Nasdaq-100 companies such as Nvidia, Apple, Google and Tesla.

title: OpenZeppelin finds data contamination in OpenAI’s EVMbench
summary: Security auditor OpenZepplin found that EVMbench’s dataset contains training data leaks and at least four invalid high-severity vulnerability classifications.
